* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 5 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 83)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 50)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1250_83">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” '''What changed:''' The quote marks around “cloak” are dropped, and the list prints the title “Obi-Wan in Radiant VII”, with a small i in “in” (card-list title capitals are versions, ruling of 10 November 2026). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1250_83">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes.
